messages:
Alyssa Park: quick sync - we need a short, concrete contract for 'degraded' responses so SDKs/console/telemetry are all aligned. who can take the RFC?
Ravi Gupta: +1. proposed definition: degraded = request completed successfully but was routed to a lower-cost/compatibility path (model variant, quantization, region fallback). not an error. keep 200 response.
Noah Lee: agree on 200. two signals we should provide: (1) machine-readable header for non-JSON clients, (2) stable JSON meta in body for SDKs.
Simone Alvarez: strongly prefer enum reasons only (no free-form text) to avoid leaking infra details. example reasons: MODEL_VARIANT, QUANTIZED, REGION_FALLBACK, TENANT_QUOTA, BURST_LIMIT.
Tara Kim: console needs: overall degraded % (24h/7d), list of sample degraded responses, and per-tenant attribution (if tenant_quota). telemetry fields must include tenant_id and quota_remaining when relevant.
Ravi Gupta: header proposal for visibility in logs: 
```
X-Redwood-Status: degraded
X-Redwood-Route: variant=quantized8;reason=QUANTIZED
```
Noah Lee: SDK JSON body meta (top-level object recommended) example: 
```
{
  "meta": {
    "status": "degraded",
    "degrade_reason": "QUANTIZED",
    "degrade_level": "soft",
    "quota_remaining": null
  },
  "output": {...}
}
```
Simone Alvarez: streaming corner: include an initial control frame with meta before the first chunk. e.g., `:meta {"status":"degraded","reason":"MODEL_VARIANT"}` — documented in streaming spec.
Alyssa Park: good. design decisions: 1) keep HTTP status semantics unchanged (200 for success), 2) provide both header + JSON meta, 3) enums only in headers/meta, 4) telemetry tag `request.outcome` with values ok/degraded/failed.
Tara Kim: rollout UX: when we enable degrade-based routing for a route, show a banner: "This route may return degraded responses up to ~X% while canary is active" and link runbook. console badge: dot colors (green/amber/red).
Ravi Gupta: tests: unit + e2e. e2e sketch for tenant_quota path: 
```
resp = http.post('/v1/generate', data=payload, headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer test'})
assert resp.status_code == 200
assert resp.headers['X-Redwood-Status'] == 'degraded'
body = resp.json()
assert body['meta']['degrade_reason'] == 'TENANT_QUOTA'
```
Noah Lee: telemetry: emit `request.outcome=degraded`, `request.degrade_reason=TENANT_QUOTA`, `request.route_variant=quantized8` and sample full trace for first 7 days, aggregated metrics for 90 days.
Simone Alvarez: security: make sure degrade_reason enum mapping is in a central repo and not expanded by infra teams without approval. scrub any internal hostnames from any client-visible fields.
Alyssa Park: ownership: I'll write the RFC and enum list. Ravi will own the header spec + server impl. Noah will update SDKs to map meta -> enums. Tara will mock console badges and the rollout banner. Simone will coordinate telemetry retention and PII checks.
DeployBot: infra-ci: build 3267810042 passed for feature/degrade-contract (sha: d4e5f6) :white_check_mark:
Tara Kim: one UX note - short human hint for SDKs only (not every raw response): map enum -> friendly phrase on console/SDK: e.g., QUANTIZED -> "Response produced with quantized model; slight quality regression possible." keep it optional.
Ravi Gupta: open question: do we expose degrade_level numeric? maybe low/medium/high or a score 0-100. prefer a coarse enum for now.
Noah Lee: +1 coarse enum. add `degrade_severity` with values NONE/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH.
Alyssa Park: ok I'll include that. timeline: RFC today, PRs in next 48h, canary banner live during rollout. thanks all. :thumbsup:
